# M8: Portfolios, agents and verdict — Plan

**Milestone:** M8 · **Status:** Draft · **Base:** — · **Last updated:** 2026-10-17 · **Roadmap:** [../../docs/roadmap.md](../../docs/roadmap.md)

Queued behind M7: promoted to `tasks/plan.md` only after M7 is done. It builds on M7's `models.ForecastRun`, `models.compare_to_baselines` and window store, M5's `research.CovComparison` and claim ledger, M4's `research.Simulator` and `research.run_backtest`, and M1's `data.preregister` and `data.unlock`. `build-setup` Extend adds Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium to the bar. Checked at promotion with `dt lint tasks/queued/`.

The build never spends the real S4 unlock: every smoke and golden case runs on synthetic snapshots with their own lock. The real final verdict is the researcher's run, once, after the milestone exits.

## Scope
**Exit:** `python -m qrp_models fport --smoke`, `agents --smoke` and `verdict --smoke` run end to end on synthetic snapshots; TC-61–TC-65 pass.
**Covers:** FPORT-01, FPORT-02, AGENT-01–AGENT-05, VERD-01–VERD-03 · **Deferred:** none
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing (test_verdict, write_verdict)

## Phase 0: Interface

### M8-T01: M8 interface
**Package:** models · **Step:** contract · **Kind:** interface · **Covers:** — · **Size:** M · **Mode:** solo
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-40, PL-41, PL-42, models.AgentRun, models.Verdict, models.ForecastRun, models.ForecastStrategy, models.AgentStrategy, research.CovComparison, research.ScoreEntry, research.Claim, research.Simulator, data.Preregistration, data.Unlock, AD-12
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] `AgentRun` and `Verdict` are code in `qrp_models/types.py`; each `tests/contracts/models.<Type>/` sample validates against its schema
- [ ] Every PL-40–PL-42 step imports with its contract signature, body `raise NotImplementedError("<its task>")`; `__main__.py` dispatches `fport`, `agents` and `verdict`; Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium are declared in `models` only (AD-01)
**Verify:** `pytest tests/contracts` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** — · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/types.py, packages/models/src/qrp_models/__main__.py, packages/models/src/qrp_models/fport/**, packages/models/src/qrp_models/agents/**, packages/models/src/qrp_models/verdict/**, packages/models/pyproject.toml, tests/contracts/models.*/**

## Phase 1: Step spines

### M8-T02: Selection of passing forecasters with the S2 covariance
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-40.passing_forecasters · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** FPORT-01 · **Size:** XS · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: `passing_forecasters` and `best_covariance` share fport/select.py; the refusal is the behaviour; TC-61 pins it
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-40, TC-61, FPORT-01, models.ForecastRun, models.compare_to_baselines, research.CovComparison
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] TC-61 passes: `lstm_a` passes; `lstm_b` raises `UnsurvivedForecaster`
- [ ] Given S2's saved comparison, when the covariance is chosen, then it is the comparison's `best` method
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k select` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/fport/select.py, tests/intent/models/test_select.py, tests/unit/models/test_select.py

### M8-T03: Forecast-driven mean-variance strategy
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-40.simulate_fport · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** FPORT-02 · **Size:** S · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: the capped long-only mean-variance solve through the simulator is the step's whole behaviour
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-40, FPORT-02, AD-08, models.ForecastStrategy, models.ForecastRun, research.CovComparison, research.Simulator, research.Rules, research.BacktestResult
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Given zero return forecasts and the covariance of M5's TC-41 (cap 1), when solved, then the weights equal minimum-variance's 0.642857, 0.285714, 0.071429 within 1e-6
- [ ] Given 50 names under the shared rules, when simulated, then every weight is ≤ 0.05 and the run validates as `research.BacktestResult`
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k fport` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/fport/optimize.py, tests/intent/models/test_fport.py, tests/unit/models/test_fport.py

### M8-T04: Gymnasium environment over the simulator
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-41.train_agents · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** AGENT-01, AGENT-02 · **Size:** S · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** the environment is its own module (agents/env.py), so it builds beside the training loop (AD-12)
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-41, AGENT-01, AGENT-02, AD-12, research.Simulator, research.DecisionContext, research.Weights, research.Rules
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Given recorded weights replayed as actions, when stepped, then after-cost returns equal `research.Simulator`'s within 1e-10
- [ ] Given any step, when the observation is built, then it holds only data through the previous close; actions are projected to long-only weights under the 5% cap before reaching the simulator
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k env` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/agents/env.py, tests/intent/models/test_env.py, tests/unit/models/test_env.py

### M8-T05: PPO training on development dates
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-41.train_agents · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** AGENT-03, AGENT-04 · **Size:** S · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: seeded PPO runs that stop before the lock are the step's whole behaviour (AD-12)
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-41, AGENT-03, AGENT-04, AD-12, models.AgentRun, models.AgentStrategy, research.Rules
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Given a synthetic universe ending 2026-10-16, when 2 seeds train for 1,000 steps, then no episode includes a day on or after 2023-10-17 and `train_end` is before it
- [ ] Given the same seed twice, when trained on the CPU, then the checkpoints' actions on a fixed observation are identical
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k train_agents` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/agents/train.py, tests/intent/models/test_train_agents.py, tests/unit/models/test_train_agents.py

### M8-T06: Environment–backtest parity check
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-41.check_parity · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** AGENT-01 · **Size:** XS · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: replaying weights through `research.run_backtest` and recording the gap is the step's whole behaviour; TC-62 pins it
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-41, TC-62, AGENT-01, models.AgentRun, research.run_backtest
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] TC-62 passes: the largest gap is ≤ 1e-10 and recorded in `parity_max_abs`
- [ ] Given an environment with a planted 1 bp cost error, when checked, then the run fails with the gap named
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k parity` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/agents/parity.py, tests/intent/models/test_parity.py, tests/unit/models/test_parity.py

### M8-T07: Agent scoring over seeds
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-41.score_agents · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** AGENT-04, AGENT-05 · **Size:** XS · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: seed medians and ranges recorded through `research.record_entry` are the step's whole behaviour
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-41, AGENT-04, AGENT-05, models.AgentRun, research.record_entry, research.ScoreEntry
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Given the 5-seed `models.AgentRun` sample, when scored, then one `research.ScoreEntry` holds median metrics with ranges for all four rule variants
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k score_agents` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/agents/score.py, tests/intent/models/test_score_agents.py, tests/unit/models/test_score_agents.py

### M8-T08: S4 pre-registration with a single unlock
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-42.preregister_s4 · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** VERD-01 · **Size:** XS · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: `preregister_s4` and `unlock_s4` share verdict/prereg.py and are thin calls into `data`; the candidate list is the behaviour
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-42, VERD-01, data.preregister, data.unlock, data.Preregistration, data.Unlock
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Given a reviewed file naming S4 and S2 candidates chosen on development data, when pre-registered, then a `data.Preregistration` for stage S4 with Sharpe after costs, alpha 0.05 and Holm is stored, and the unlock references it
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k prereg` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/verdict/prereg.py, tests/intent/models/test_prereg.py, tests/unit/models/test_prereg.py

### M8-T09: Held-out entries at both costs
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-42.held_out_entries · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** VERD-03 · **Size:** XS · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: scoring every candidate at the four rule variants on the held-out years is the step's whole behaviour; TC-65 pins it
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-42, TC-65, VERD-03, research.ScoreEntry, research.record_entry, data.Preregistration, data.Unlock
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] TC-65 passes: every candidate × variant has Sharpe, volatility, turnover and maximum drawdown, starting 2023-10-17
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k held_out_entries` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/verdict/entries.py, tests/intent/models/test_held_out_entries.py, tests/unit/models/test_held_out_entries.py

### M8-T10: Verdict significance test
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-42.test_verdict · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** VERD-02 · **Size:** XS · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: the test is the step; designed with `null-hypothesis-testing`; own module (verdict/test.py)
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing
**Read:** PL-42, VERD-02, research.ScoreEntry, research.record_claim, research.Claim, data.Preregistration
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Given entries for three strategies and a pre-registration comparing two, when tested, then only the pre-registered comparison is a `verdict`-family claim, Holm-corrected over the pre-registered set
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k test_verdict` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/verdict/test.py, tests/intent/models/test_verdict_claims.py, tests/unit/models/test_verdict_claims.py

### M8-T11: Verdict report
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-42.write_verdict · **Kind:** thicken · **Covers:** VERD-02, VERD-03 · **Size:** XS · **Mode:** split
**Reason:** fold: mapping corrected claims to one of three summaries is the step's whole behaviour
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing
**Read:** PL-42, VERD-02, VERD-03, models.Verdict, research.Claim, research.ScoreEntry
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Given a non-rejected claim, the summary is "no significant difference"; given a rejected claim with S4 ahead, "S4 beats S2"; with S2 ahead, "S2 beats S4"
- [ ] The report lists volatility, turnover and drawdown at 5 bp and 15 bp for every compared strategy
**Verify:** `pytest tests/intent/models tests/unit/models -k write_verdict` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T01 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/verdict/report.py, tests/intent/models/test_write_verdict.py, tests/unit/models/test_write_verdict.py

## Phase 2: Wiring and thicken

### M8-T12: Wire PL-40
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-40 · **Kind:** wiring · **Covers:** FPORT-01, FPORT-02 · **Size:** S · **Mode:** solo
**Reason:** fold: `record_fport` is a pass-through to `research.record_entry`, built here
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-40, TC-61, research.record_entry
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] `python -m qrp_models fport --smoke` records one forecast-driven entry with all four rule variants on a synthetic snapshot; committed as PL-40's smoke test
- [ ] PL-40 pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
**Verify:** `python -m qrp_models fport --smoke` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T02, M8-T03 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/fport/pipeline.py, tests/unit/models/test_pl40_smoke.py

### M8-T13: Wire PL-41
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-41 · **Kind:** wiring · **Covers:** AGENT-01–AGENT-05 · **Size:** S · **Mode:** solo
**Skills:** —
**Read:** PL-41, TC-62, TC-63
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] `python -m qrp_models agents --smoke` trains 2 seeds for 1,000 steps, checks parity and scores; committed as PL-41's smoke test
- [ ] TC-63 passes: one entry with 5 seeds, medians and ranges, all four variants
- [ ] PL-41 pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
**Verify:** `python -m qrp_models agents --smoke` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T04, M8-T05, M8-T06, M8-T07 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/agents/pipeline.py, tests/unit/models/test_pl41_smoke.py

### M8-T14: Wire PL-42
**Package:** models · **Step:** PL-42 · **Kind:** wiring · **Covers:** VERD-01–VERD-03 · **Size:** S · **Mode:** solo
**Skills:** null-hypothesis-testing
**Read:** PL-42, PL-04, TC-64, TC-65
**Acceptance:**
- [ ] `python -m qrp_models verdict --smoke` runs pre-registration, unlock, entries, test and report on a synthetic snapshot with its own lock; committed as PL-42's smoke test
- [ ] TC-64 passes: Sharpe 0.7 vs 0.5 over 156 weeks gives "no significant difference"; the unregistered Sharpe-2.0 strategy is not in the verdict
- [ ] PL-42 pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
**Verify:** `python -m qrp_models verdict --smoke` · `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg models`
**Depends on:** M8-T08, M8-T09, M8-T10, M8-T11 · **Writes:** packages/models/src/qrp_models/verdict/pipeline.py, tests/unit/models/test_pl42_smoke.py

### Checkpoint after M8-T14
- [ ] Every pipeline in the milestone runs end to end (smoke commands)
- [ ] All golden cases pass
- [ ] Entry functions still read top to bottom as the step table says (Sync if not)
- [ ] No new abstraction without a second implementation or an AD
- [ ] contract.md matches the contract code (`dt status` freshness check)
- [ ] `dt layout` output reviewed; Definition of Done holds
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh full` passes; Review checklist done; every finding has a disposition

### Checkpoint: milestone exit

- [ ] contract.md matches the contract code (`dt status` freshness check)

- [ ] `scripts/check.sh full --exit` passes; Review checklist done; every finding has a disposition
- [ ] The Scope's Exit holds

## Dependency graph
| From | To | Kind | Mitigated by |
|---|---|---|---|
| M8-T03 forecast-driven strategy | M8-T02 selection | data | models.ForecastRun and research.CovComparison samples (M8-T01) |
| M8-T05 PPO training | M8-T04 environment | call | research.Simulator replay double and the environment's stub signature (M8-T01) |
| M8-T06 parity check | M8-T05 PPO training | data | models.AgentRun sample (M8-T01) |
| M8-T07 agent scoring | M8-T06 parity check | data | models.AgentRun sample (M8-T01) |
| M8-T09 held-out entries | M8-T08 pre-registration | data | data.Preregistration and data.Unlock samples (M8-T01) |
| M8-T10 verdict test | M8-T09 held-out entries | data | research.ScoreEntry sample (M8-T01) |
| M8-T11 verdict report | M8-T10 verdict test | data | research.Claim sample (M8-T01) |
| M8-T12 wire PL-40 | M8-T02 selection | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T12 wire PL-40 | M8-T03 forecast-driven strategy | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T13 wire PL-41 | M8-T04 environment | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T13 wire PL-41 | M8-T05 PPO training | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T13 wire PL-41 | M8-T06 parity check | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T13 wire PL-41 | M8-T07 agent scoring | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T14 wire PL-42 | M8-T08 pre-registration | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T14 wire PL-42 | M8-T09 held-out entries | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T14 wire PL-42 | M8-T10 verdict test | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |
| M8-T14 wire PL-42 | M8-T11 verdict report | order | none: integration: the smoke runs it |

## Risks
| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| A build or test run uses the real S4 unlock | The held-out years are spent before the real verdict | Every test and smoke uses synthetic snapshots with their own lock; the real `verdict` run is the researcher's, after exit |
| PPO training is slow or unstable on weekly steps over about 500 names | Agents take hours or don't converge | Smoke uses 25 names and 1,000 steps; real runs size the network small and log seeds; non-convergence is a result, not a blocker |
| Simulator speed limits PPO sample throughput (AD-12) | Real training exceeds a sensible time | Vectorised environments over seeds; profile in M8-T13 |
| AD-14's Grow re-check for `models` splits agents from forecasting | Contract IDs rename before M8 starts | Promotion re-runs the Grow check |

## Open questions
- `record_fport` is folded into PL-40's wiring as a pass-through (assumed).
- No system task: every call goes to `research` and `data` as built.
- The real final verdict (one S4 unlock on the real snapshot) is your run after M8 exits, not a build task (assumed).

## Replan notes

I've drafted the M8 plan as a queued plan in `tasks/queued/M8-portfolios-agents-verdict.md`, status Draft, behind M7. Lint shows zero errors, and the task context packets I checked resolve at 66–174 lines.

## Scope
- **Exit:** the `fport`, `agents` and `verdict` smoke commands run end to end on synthetic snapshots, and TC-61 to TC-65 pass.
- **Covers:** FPORT-01, FPORT-02, AGENT-01 to AGENT-05 and VERD-01 to VERD-03. Nothing is deferred.
- **Skills:** `null-hypothesis-testing` on the verdict test and the verdict report.
- **The build never spends the real S4 unlock.** Every test and smoke run uses a synthetic snapshot with its own lock. The real final verdict is your run, once, after M8 exits.

## Tasks (14)

| Task | What it does | Proof |
|---|---|---|
| T01 interface | `AgentRun` and `Verdict` types; stubs for PL-40 to PL-42; CLI subcommands; Stable-Baselines3 and Gymnasium declared in `models` only | Samples validate |
| T02 | Picks forecasters that beat their baselines, plus the best covariance estimator from S2 | TC-61; the covariance is S2's `best` |
| T03 | Forecast-driven mean-variance strategy | With zero forecasts it matches TC-41's minimum-variance weights; 5% cap on 50 names |
| T04 | Gymnasium environment over the simulator | Replayed weights match the simulator within 1e-10; observations end at the previous close; actions projected under the cap |
| T05 | PPO training on development dates | Never touches 2023-10-17 or later; same seed gives the same actions |
| T06 | Check that the environment matches the backtest | TC-62; a planted 1 bp error fails |
| T07 | Agent scoring over seeds | Medians and ranges for all four variants |
| T08 | S4 pre-registration with a single unlock | S4 and S2 candidates; Sharpe after costs, 5%, Holm |
| T09 | Held-out entries at both costs | TC-65 |
| T10 | Verdict significance test | Only pre-registered comparisons are tested |
| T11 | Verdict report | Picks one of the three summaries; costs at 5 bp and 15 bp |
| T12–T14 | Wiring for PL-40 to PL-42 | Smoke tests; TC-63 on PL-41; TC-64 on PL-42 |

- **Parallelism:** wave 1 runs 10 tasks at once (T02–T11).
- **Longest chain:** 3 tasks (interface → step → wiring).

## Assumptions
- **`record_fport` is built during PL-40's wiring,** because it only passes the result through to `research.record_entry`.
- **No system task:** every call goes to `research` and `data` as built.
- **The real verdict is not a build task.** It's your run after exit.

## Risks
- **Spending the real held-out years by accident.** Guarded by synthetic locks in every test and smoke run.
- **PPO training may be slow or fail to converge.** The smoke runs are small (25 names, 1,000 steps), and an agent that doesn't converge counts as a result, not a blocker.
- **The simulator's speed limits how fast agents can train.** T13 profiles it.
- **The package-size re-check at promotion** could split `models` into forecasting and agents.

**Do you approve the M8 plan?** I'll commit it on a yes.

**After that, every remaining planning step depends on the probes.** All of S2 to S4 (M4 to M8) is queued. What's left (M1 to M3, the quality bar via `build-setup`, and the start of the build) needs PB-01 and PB-02. When you're ready, run `python3 probe.py ping; echo "exit=$?"` in `probes/PB-01-sharadar-coverage/`, then tell me the exit number and `python3 --version`.
